## Verification

## Review checklist

- [ ] No secrets, personal databases, résumés, uploads, or visitor data
- [ ] Alembic migration and previous-version upgrade test added when schema changed
- [ ] Chinese and English fixed copy updated together
- [ ] Mobile, keyboard, focus, and reduced-motion behavior checked for UI changes
- [ ] Upload authorization and validation considered
- [ ] Documentation and screenshots updated
